name: What are common signs of wind damage to a roof?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs of wind damage to a roof?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs of wind damage include missing or creased shingles, granules in gutters, uplifted or curled shingles, and debris on the roof or in the yard. After a severe weather event in the DFW area, it's advisable to perform a visual inspection from the ground. If you notice any of these indicators, a professional inspection can determine the extent of the damage and necessary repairs. The type of shingle and its age can influence how wind damage manifests.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common signs of wind damage are missing or creased shingles, granules in gutters, uplifted shingles, and roof debris. A professional inspection can confirm the damage.
